consequence.statement: Additive feature with no stated change to existing behavior: the logstash output client gains the ability to send structured metadata, and environments that do nothing keep their current behavior.

assertion.statement: Loki 3.0.0 adds structured metadata support to the clients logstash output, an additive feature with no stated change to existing behavior.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The changelog headline names only the feature area ('clients logstash output structured metadata support'); it does not identify a concrete setting, config key, field, flag, or interface, so the subject identity cannot be pinned from the evidence.; applicability: The evidence states no exposure condition; whether an environment uses the Loki logstash output client is configured in Logstash (a separate product's pipeline configuration), which none of the Loki configuration predicates (values-key, cli-flag, configmap-file text-line, etc.) can read, so no condition tree can be expressed.
